verses.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ੩੧ : ਛੇਵੇਂ ਗੁਰੂ ਜੀ ਦੇ ਸਿੱਖ
verses.translit_en: pauRee 31 : chheve(n) guroo jee dhe si'kh

verses.gurmukhi: ਸੁਹੰਢੈ ਮਾਈਆ ਲੰਮੁ ਹੈ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਗਾਵੈ ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ।
verses.translit_en: suha(n)ddai maieeaa la(n)m hai saadhasa(n)gat gaavai gurbaanee|

en.bdb: In village Suhanda is Bhai maia of lamb caste who sings the holy hymns in the holy congregation.

verses.gurmukhi: ਚੂਹੜ ਚਉਝੜੁ ਲਖਣਊ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮ ਵਖਾਣੀ।
verses.translit_en: choohaR chaujhaR lakhanuoo gurmukh anadhin naam vakhaanee|

en.bdb: Chuhar of Chaujhar caste from Lucknow is gurmukh who remembers Lord day and night.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਨਮੁਖ ਸਿਖੁ ਪਿਰਾਗ ਵਿਚ ਭਾਈ ਭਾਨਾ ਵਿਰਤੀਹਾਣੀ।
verses.translit_en: sanamukh sikh piraag vich bhaiee bhaanaa virateehaanee|

en.bdb: Bhai Bhana of Prayag is a close Sikh who earns his livelihood.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜਟੂ ਤਪਾ ਸੁ ਜੌਨਪੁਰਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਿਹਚਲ ਸੇਵ ਕਮਾਣੀ।
verses.translit_en: jaToo tapaa su jauanapur gurmat nihachal sev kamaanee|

en.bdb: Jattu and Tappa, the residents of Jaunpur have served in accordance with Gurmat with stable mind.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਟਣੈ ਸਭਰਵਾਲ ਹੈ ਨਵਲੁ ਨਿਹਾਲਾ ਸੁਧ ਪਰਾਣੀ।
verses.translit_en: paTanai sabharavaal hai naval nihaalaa sudh paraanee|

en.bdb: In Patna Bhai naval and among Sabhaervals Nihala is a pious person.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਤਾ ਸੇਠ ਵਖਾਣੀਐ ਵਿਣੁ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਹੋਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੀ।
verses.translit_en: jaitaa seTh vakhaaneeaai vin gur sevaa hor na jaanee|

en.bdb: One wealthy person is known by the name of Jaita who likes nothing except the service of the Guru.

verses.gurmukhi: ਰਾਜ ਮਹਿਲ ਭਾਨੂ ਬਹਿਲੁ ਭਾਉ ਭਗਤਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਣੀ।
verses.translit_en: raaj mahil bhaanoo bahil bhaau bhagat gurmat man bhaanee|

en.bdb: Of Rajmahal city is Bhanu Bahal whose mind is absorbed in the wisdom of the Guru and the loving devotion.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਨਮੁਖੁ ਸੋਢੀ ਬਦਲੀ ਸੇਠ ਗੁਪਾਲੈ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਜਾਣੀ।
verses.translit_en: sanamukh soddee badhalee seTh gupaalai gurmat jaanee|

en.bdb: Badali Sodhi and Gopal, the rich persons understand the Gurmat.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸੁੰਦਰੁ ਚਢਾ ਆਗਰੈ ਢਾਕੈ ਮੋਹਣਿ ਸੇਵ ਕਮਾਣੀ।
verses.translit_en: su(n)dhar chaddaa aagarai ddaakai mohan sev kamaanee|

en.bdb: Sundar Chaddha of Agra and Bhai Mohan a resident of Dhakka have served and cultivated the true earning.
I am sacrifice unto the holy congregation.
